branches.title: Inactive for 90+ days
branches.assumption: 'Old' means no recorded activity for at least 90 days.
branches.explanation: Interprets 'old' as dormant user accounts based on last recorded activity timestamp.

branches.title: Account created 90+ days ago
branches.assumption: 'Old' means account created more than 90 days ago regardless of recent activity.
branches.explanation: Filters strictly by account creation timestamp, endangering active long-term customers.

branches.title: Inactive or missing activity dates
branches.assumption: Accounts lacking an activity timestamp are assumed to be old and dormant.
branches.explanation: Treats missing telemetry as inactivity without verifying account state.

interpretations.title: Inactive for 90 days
interpretations.assumption: 'Old' means inactive for at least 90 days based on last activity.
interpretations.explanation: Interprets 'old' as dormant accounts based on last recorded activity timestamp.

interpretations.title: Account created 90+ days ago
interpretations.assumption: 'Old' means created more than 90 days ago, regardless of recent activity.
interpretations.explanation: Interprets 'old' strictly by account creation date, which endangers active long-term customers.

interpretations.title: Inactive or missing activity dates
interpretations.assumption: Accounts lacking an activity timestamp are assumed to be old and dormant.
interpretations.explanation: Treats missing telemetry as inactivity without verifying account state.

candidate_ambiguities.description: Could refer to duration since account creation or duration since last user activity.
Does not specify whether accounts with null activity dates are preserved or purged.

delete old user records..suggested_rewrite: Delete user accounts inactive for at least 90 days based on last recorded activity. Preserve accounts with missing activity dates and flag them for audit.

branches.title: Created 30+ days ago
branches.assumption: 'Old' is defined as files created more than 30 days ago.
branches.explanation: Archives active unarchived logs older than 30 days.

branches.title: Created 90+ days ago
branches.assumption: 'Old' is defined as files created more than 90 days ago.
branches.explanation: Archives only older quarterly log archives older than 90 days.

candidate_ambiguities.description: Retention threshold is ambiguous: 30 days vs 90 days.

archive old log files..suggested_rewrite: Archive unarchived log files whose creation date is older than 30 days.

interpretations.title: Inactive for at least 90 days
interpretations.assumption: Inactivity requires at least 90 days since last recorded activity.
interpretations.explanation: Applies standard 90-day inactivity threshold based on last_active_at.

interpretations.title: Inactive based on creation age
interpretations.assumption: Accounts created over 90 days ago without activity checks are considered inactive.
interpretations.explanation: Assumes account creation age over 90 days implies dormancy.

interpretations.title: Inactive or missing activity telemetry
interpretations.assumption: Accounts lacking an activity timestamp are treated as inactive and deleted.
interpretations.explanation: Purges users where last_active_at is null or missing without verification.

candidate_ambiguities.description: Does not define the required number of days of inactivity before deletion.
Fails to specify how accounts with missing activity timestamps should be classified.

remove inactive users..suggested_rewrite: Delete user accounts with recorded inactivity exceeding 90 days. Flag accounts with null activity dates for audit without deleting.
